Title: Vihaan's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Vihaan - 11 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Neeta - 34 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Karan - 42 years, father
Look: glasses, brown sweater

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The courtyard - Night

[Vihaan stands in the courtyard. Neeta stands near him.]

Neeta: "It's very late tonight."

[A full moon shines in the sky.]

Vihaan: "What happened?"

[Fireflies glow in the dark.]

Neeta: "That was such a fun day!"
